method: Deterministic static contract audit over all 24 redesigned pages + shared chrome + CSS stack dark-twin/alias analysis. Dark/Light/Default share one resolved look (html[data-theme]). Playwright runtime paint checks blocked here (libnspr4 missing).
scope: Only paths in data/redesigned-pages.json. Education / legacy style.css out of v1 by product lock.
